source_summary: Chinese spring landscape with a large mist-washed mountain at left, blossom-filled riverside village below, foreground plum trees, layered riverbanks and water to the right, a small boat with figures, and faint distant boats/island forms. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_misty_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the large left-side mountain rising behind the village, including its rounded peak, sloping shoulders, mist-softened lower contours, and darker central rocky strata.
must_preserve: darker layered rock ledges near the center-right face

motifs.name: central_rocky_cliff_terraces
motifs.description: Isolate the darker terraced cliff section embedded on the mountain face, with stepped horizontal ledges and scrubby ink marks.
must_preserve: integration with pale surrounding wash edges

motifs.name: riverside_village_rooftops
motifs.description: Isolate the cluster of pale village roofs nestled among blossoms in the lower left-middle, including overlapping gabled houses and diagonal roof tile lines.

motifs.name: midground_blossom_belt
motifs.description: Isolate the continuous band of spring blossom shrubs and small trees stretching behind the village toward the right bank.
must_preserve: dense magenta and purple blossom dots
soft transition into the mountain and bank washes

motifs.name: foreground_plum_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dark foreground plum trees at the lower left, with branching trunks, exposed roots, and clusters of magenta blossoms.
must_preserve: deep red and purple blossom accents
layered dry-brush grasses and low foliage at the base

motifs.name: right_layered_riverbank
motifs.description: Isolate the misty shoreline and low hills on the right side, including the projecting bank, receding horizontal land strips, and soft water-edge washes.
must_preserve: subtle darker brush accents along the bank

motifs.name: small_family_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the small skiff on the lower right water with seated figures and a standing boatman using an oar.
must_preserve: thin ink outline of the narrow boat
standing or crouched boatman at the stern
tiny dark hair and robe accents

motifs.name: distant_mist_boats_and_island
motifs.description: Isolate the faint distant forms near the upper sky-water area: pale small sailboats and the low grey island or cloud-like landform near the top.
must_preserve: tiny boat shapes with suggested sails
minimal brush marks that imply distance and mist

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
